fee_notes: Royalty: 5% of gross sales or minimum royalty, whichever is greater. Minimum royalty tiered by months in operation: $0 for months 1–6; $1,000/mo for 7–9 months; $1,400/mo for 10–12 months; $1,800/mo for 13–15 months; $2,250/mo for 16–18 months; $2,700/mo for 19–21 months; $5,000/mo for 22+ months. Marketing: up to 1% of gross sales. Technology Development Fee: $2,300/mo (required). IT as a Service: $130/user/mo (required first 36 months). Additional: Accounting $2,500/mo (first 12 months), Business Development $3,500/mo (first 12 months), software licenses, payroll services, and optional services.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee: The greater of 5% of total Gross Sales or the Minimum Royalty Fee, payable monthly. National Marketing Fund: Up to 1% of total Gross Sales. Technology Development Fee: $2,300 per month. IT As A Service: $130 per user, per month for the first thirty-six months of operations.
